verses.text: This is the message the LORD gave to Micah from Moresheth during the time when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah. It is what he saw about Samaria and Jerusalem.
Listen, all you nations! Pay attention, earth and everything in it! The Lord GOD will be a witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
Look! The LORD is coming out of his dwelling place. He comes down and walks on the high places of the earth.
The mountains melt beneath him, and the valleys split apart, like wax near a fire, like water rushing down a slope.
All this is because of Jacob's rebellion and Israel's sins. What is Jacob's rebellion? Isn't it Samaria? Where are Judah's high places of idol worship? Aren't they in Jerusalem?
"So I will turn Samaria into a pile of rubble in a field, a place for planting vineyards. I will pour her stones down into the valley and lay bare her foundations.

All her idols will be smashed to pieces. All the gifts given at her temples will be burned. I will destroy all her images. She collected them with the wages of a prostitute, and they will be used again to pay prostitutes."
Because of this I will weep and wail. I will walk around barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.
Samaria's wound cannot be healed. It has spread to Judah. It has reached the gate of my people, even Jerusalem itself.
Do not tell it in Gath. Do not weep at all. In Beth Ophrah, roll in the dust.
Go into exile, you who live in Shaphir, naked and ashamed. Those who live in Zaanan will not come out. Beth Ezel is mourning, and it can no longer protect you.
Those who live in Maroth wait anxiously for relief, but disaster has come from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.
You who live in Lachish, hitch the fast horses to your chariots. You were where the sin of the people of Zion began, because Israel's rebellion was found in you.
So you will give farewell gifts to Moresheth Gath. The town of Achzib will prove false to the kings of Israel.
You who live in Mareshah, I will bring a conqueror against you. The leaders of Israel will flee to the cave of Adullam.
Shave your heads in mourning for the children you love. Make yourselves as bald as a vulture, because they will be taken away from you into exile.
